object.heading: Automated Clause and Risk Identification
object.what_it_is: AI contract review tools leverage advanced algorithms for accurate **Risk Spotting**, immediately highlighting potential liabilities and missing terms within legal documents. They meticulously flag **Non-standard Language** that diverges from approved templates or regulatory guidelines, ensuring quick attention to deviations. This proactive identification is fundamental to robust contract management.
object.why_it_works: This automation significantly accelerates legal review processes, reducing manual effort and enhancing consistency. By providing **Plain-English risk explanations**, these tools allow broader business understanding, bolstering compliance and mitigating legal exposure across all contracts efficiently.
object.experience_or_data_point: Industry data indicates that AI-powered contract review can reduce manual review time by up to 80%, allowing legal professionals to focus on strategic tasks.

example_brands: LegalOn Technologies: Their AI identifies specific contract risks and provides redlining suggestions based on jurisdiction-specific regulations, flagging non-compliant clauses.
Evisort: This platform flags anomalous clauses in M&A agreements, comparing them against a vast database of similar contracts for risk assessment and non-standard language detection.
copy_formula: Start with the challenge of manual risk identification, then introduce automated clause identification as the precise, efficient solution.
Detail how non-standard language is detected, then explain its direct impact on compliance and negotiation strategy.
Highlight the benefit of plain-English risk explanations, showing how it democratizes legal understanding for all stakeholders.
object.takeaway: AI revolutionizes contract review by automating precise risk identification and translating complex legal risks into accessible insights for all business functions.
